# Services

Everything `make up` starts. Host ports are bound to `127.0.0.1` only; override a port with the variable in brackets.

| Service | What it is | Image | Host port | Command |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rabbitmq` | Message broker. Delivers task messages; its ack, requeue and dead-letter behaviour is what the experiments study. | rabbitmq:4.3-management | 15672 | — |
| `redis` | Celery result backend; also holds the chord's bookkeeping. | redis:8-alpine | 6380 (`REDIS_PORT`) | — |
| `postgres` | Durable workflow state (calls, call_chunks, task_execution_log): the source of truth that tasks claim work against. | postgres:18-alpine | 5432 (`POSTGRES_PORT`) | — |
| `bootstrap` | One-shot setup: creates the database schema and declares the RabbitMQ exchanges and queues, including the dead-letter topology. | call-pipeline:dev | — | `python -m app.bootstrap` |
| `api` | The pipeline's HTTP API: starts calls, exposes their state, peeks at the dead-letter queue. | call-pipeline:dev | 8100 (`API_PORT`) | `uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000` |
| `worker-spot` ×2 | The 'Spot fleet': consumes heavy_processing, 2 containers of 1 process each. The chaos scripts kill these. | call-pipeline:dev | — | `celery -A app.celery_app:celery_app worker -Q heavy_processing -c 1 -n spot@%h -l INFO` |
| `worker-core` | The 'on-demand' worker: runs ingest, the chord callback and the Task Police. Never evicted. | call-pipeline:dev | — | `celery -A app.celery_app:celery_app worker -Q default,priority -c 2 -n core@%h -l INFO` |
| `beat` | Celery's scheduler: publishes the Task Police sweep periodically. | call-pipeline:dev | — | `celery -A app.celery_app:celery_app beat -l INFO -s /tmp/celerybeat-schedule` |
| `flower` | Fleet-level dashboard and Prometheus metrics (aggregates, not per-workflow). Runs from the project image so it shares the Celery config. | call-pipeline:dev | 5555 | `celery -A app.celery_app:celery_app flower --broker_api=http://pipeline:pipeline@rabbitmq:15672/api/ --port=5555` |
| `viz` | The workflow visualizer: API plus web UI. Observes the event stream; launching demo scenarios is opt-in (--catalog). | call-pipeline:dev | 8200 (`VIZ_PORT`) | `python -m celery_viz --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8200 --hung-after 20 --lost-after 6 --drain-grace 30 --ignore-task tasks.police_sweep --catalog app.viz_catalog:catalog --queue-metrics-url http://rabbitmq:15692/metrics/detailed?family=queue_coarse_metrics` |
